# Ara Khan

> Personal site of Ara Khan (Arafat Khan, @arafatkatze), founding engineer at Cline, the open-source AI coding agent. Ara builds and evaluates AI coding agents: agent harnesses, eval pipelines, hill climbing on Terminal-Bench, recursive self-improvement, open-weight models and LLM inference economics. The site also holds Ara's personal essays and interactive art.

Start with the profile, which is written for AI assistants and kept current. Every post and project below also has a Markdown copy.

## Profile

- [AI profile (Markdown)](https://arafatkatze.com/ai.md): who Ara is, current role, career, results, talks, short bios and contact details
- [Résumé (JSON Resume)](https://arafatkatze.com/assets/json/resume.json): structured work history, education, awards and talks
- [Full text of all writing](https://arafatkatze.com/llms-full.txt): every essay and project write-up in one Markdown file

## AI engineering work

- [11,840 TPS on a single GPU](https://arafatkatze.com/projects/nemotronInference/index.md): Nearly doubling Nemotron throughput on one GB300, with interactive explainers for speculative decoding, scheduling, and self-tuning inference.
- [Computer Use Field Notes](https://arafatkatze.com/projects/computerUseFieldNotes/index.md): Eval runs to improve computer-use UX — OSWorld experiments on smaller screenshots, running task notes, and batched GUI actions, with every trace public.
- [DeepSeek wins IMO Gold on 12 cents](https://arafatkatze.com/projects/deepseek-wins-imo-gold-on-12-cents/index.md): DeepSeek V4 Flash scored 30/42 on IMO 2026 in Cline, clearing the gold cutoff for $0.12 — about 140 times cheaper than Claude Fable 5.
- [The Math of LLM Inference](https://arafatkatze.com/projects/inferenceMath/index.md): How to save millions by self-hosting LLMs — the math of inference and the real dollars, grounded in production traffic.
- [LLM Visualization](https://arafatkatze.com/projects/llmVisualization/index.md): A GPT drawn at full resolution — all 85,728 parameters, every activation, and a guided walkthrough from tokens to output probabilities. Runs the model live in your browser.
- [Open-sourcing evals for open-weight agents](https://arafatkatze.com/projects/open-weight-agent-evals/index.md): The Hill Climber's Checklist for evaluating open-weight agents, with scores, tradeoffs, and public traces.
- [Public Speaking](https://arafatkatze.com/projects/publicSpeaking/index.md): Talks and conference videos on AI agents, evals, and machine learning
- [Recursive Self Improvement for Coding Agents](https://arafatkatze.com/projects/recursiveSelfImprovement/index.md): How one prompt turned a 17-hour autonomous hill climb into an 88.8% state-of-the-art Terminal-Bench 2.1 score.
- [A Practical Guide to Hill Climbing](https://arafatkatze.com/projects/HillClimbing/index.md): Iterative improvement for AI coding agents
- [Ruby TensorFlow](https://arafatkatze.com/projects/rubyTensorflow/index.md): Porting TensorFlow to Ruby with the tensorflow.rb gem — the Ruby API, how Google Protobuf drives the graph internals, and Inception-v3 image recognition in Ruby.
- [Agentic AI writings](https://arafatkatze.com/projects/AgenticAi/index.md)
